sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling at the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should represent a straightforward opportunity for the leaders to extend their impressive run.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a match between two strong performers, with both sides competing in the upper half. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face Wednesfield Community at home as they bid to maintain their title challenge. Bilston Town, fifth, host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Elsewhere, Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (a contest between the two lowest-scoring teams), Crewe host Allscott Heath, Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town (the division's bottom-placed side), and Shawbury United entertain Barnton. New Mills, Wednesfield Community, and Barnton all sit in the middle-to-lower reaches and will be keen to pick up points, while winless Widnes Town continue to struggle.
